title: List the unwatched titles
prompt: `Movie` and `Sample` are supplied. `UnwatchedTitles(List<Movie> movies)` should return the titles of the movies that are not watched, in their original order. The starter returns the title of every movie.
hints: Which step decides whether a movie is kept, and which step turns a movie into a title?
Filter before you transform: Where comes before Select.
Add .Where(movie => !movie.Watched) in front of the Select.
checkLabels: From the sample movies, the result must be Jaws, Heat, Count in that order.
An empty list must give an empty list.
A list with only watched movies must give an empty list.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Keeps the watched movies instead of the unwatched ones.
Sorts the titles, which changes the original order.

feedback: Compare your result with the sample movies one by one. Check which movies are kept and that their order is unchanged.
